text_en: To the leader: according to The Gittith. Of the Korahites. A Psalm.
text_cn: 科辣黑子孙的诗歌，交与乐官。调寄"加特"。

text_en: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord of hosts!
text_cn: 万军的上主，你的居所是多么的可爱！

text_en: My soul longs, indeed it faints for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and my flesh sing for joy to the living God.
text_cn: 我的灵魂对上主的宫庭渴慕及缅怀。 我的心灵以及我的肉身， 向生活的天主踊跃欢欣。

text_en: Even the sparrow finds a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, at your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
text_cn: 万军的上主，我的君王，我的天主， 麻雀靠近你的祭坛找到了住所， 燕子也找到了安置幼雏的窝巢。

text_en: Happy are those who live in your house, ever singing your praise. Selah
text_cn: 上主，居住在你的殿宇， 常赞美你的，真是有福！ （休止）

text_en: Happy are those whose strength is in you, in whose heart are the highways to Zion.
text_cn: 那以你作为自己的助佑， 居心朝圣的人，真是有福！

text_en: As they go through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; the early rain also covers it with pools.
text_cn: 他们把他们经过的干谷变为水泉， 并以初雨给干谷披上祝福的衣衫。

text_en: They go from strength to strength; the God of gods will be seen in Zion.
text_cn: 他们的体力越行越有， 到熙雍觐见至高天主。

text_en: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob! Selah
text_cn: 万军的上主，求你允我的恳请， 雅各伯的天主，求你侧耳倾听！ （休止）

text_en: Behold our shield, O God; look on the face of your anointed.
text_cn: 天主，我们的护盾，求你目睹， 请对你的受傅者予以回顾。

text_en: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than live in the tents of wickedness.
text_cn: 的确在你宫庭逗留一日， 远胜过在别处逗留千日。 我宁愿站在我天主殿宇的门限， 我不愿逗留在恶人帐幔的里面，

text_en: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; he bestows favor and honor. No good thing does the Lord withhold from those who walk uprightly.
text_cn: 因为上主天主是太阳，是护盾。 上主常广施恩爱和光荣； 他对行为正直纯洁的人， 从来不会拒绝赐福赐幸。

text_en: O Lord of hosts, happy is everyone who trusts in you.
text_cn: 万军的上主，依赖你的， 那人才算是真有福的。
